comparison.objective: Mount the final bicycle-tire bead section without damaging the tube; candidate installs and recovers load-rated lifting hardware while transferring a workpiece.
comparison.physical_skill: Tire-bead deformation and bimanual pressing versus close-clearance pin insertion, ball locking, shackle lifting, supported seating, and unlocked extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Bead fully seated, valve aligned, tube undamaged, and hands clear versus verified pin retention, supported lift, three-pad seating, pin removal, clearance, and 3 s dwell.
comparison.reason: The tasks test deformable tire mounting versus a rigid temporary-lifting-hardware lifecycle; all material rubric details needed for distinction are present.
